RCSB title/DOI mapping is sparse for many current Europe PMC articles, so absent PDB mappings are not negative structural evidence.
evidence_for: Bounded Europe PMC source-text mapping produced articles and/or RCSB rows but no local-metal ePK substrate candidate.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Continue bounded source-text searches only; source-map any future article-to-PDB hit with local-metal non-peptide geometry before treating it as evidence. Keep production paths closed.
